BiblicalUsage: The little one, or child, is the smallest in the family. Saul was commanded to slay man and woman, infant and suckling, among the Amalekites, and Elisha wept as he told Hazael that he would dash the children of Israel to pieces.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the little ones are the ones God sees first: the command to slay them is the hardest in the Bible, and the prophet wept over it.
